get_environments.name: get_environments
get_environments.description: Retrieves environment configurations with comprehensive details including build settings, deployment information, password protection, and recent commits using cursor-based pagination. Returns empty commits if the project was created by file upload and not connected to GitHub. Includes cursor values for efficient pagination through large datasets.

first.description: Number of environments to fetch from the current position (e.g., first: 10 for the next 10 environments). Used for forward pagination through environments list.

after.description: Cursor position to start fetching environments from. Use the 'cursor' value from the last environment in a previous query to get the next page. Omit this parameter to start from the beginning.

commitsFirst.description: Number of commits to fetch for each environment starting from the most recent (e.g., commitsFirst: 10 for the 10 most recent commits). Will return empty if the project is not connected to GitHub.

commitsAfter.description: Cursor position to start fetching commits from for each environment. Use the 'cursor' value from the last commit in a previous query to get older commits. Omit this parameter to start from the most recent commits.

notes: Each environment and commit edge includes a 'cursor' field for precise pagination
Forward-only pagination using 'after' cursors provides better performance than offset-based pagination
Commits will be empty for projects created via file upload (not connected to Git repositories)
Use the cursor from the last item in the edges array to fetch the next page
Cursor values are opaque strings and should not be parsed or modified

get_deploy_hooks.name: get_deploy_hooks
get_deploy_hooks.description: Retrieves deploy hooks configurations with filtering capabilities using cursor-based pagination. Deploy hooks are automated triggers that initiate deployments when specific conditions are met, such as webhook calls or repository changes.

query.description: Query filters to search for specific deploy hooks. This input object defines the search criteria such as environment ID.

environment.description: Filter deploy hooks by environment UID

first.description: Number of deploy hooks to fetch from the current position (e.g., first: 10 for the next 10 deploy hooks). Used for forward pagination through the deploy hooks list.

after.description: Cursor position to start fetching deploy hooks from. Use the 'cursor' value from the last deploy hook in a previous query to get the next page. Omit this parameter to start from the beginning.

notes: The 'query' parameter is required and must be an object containing filter criteria
Each deploy hook edge includes a 'cursor' field for precise pagination
Deploy hooks contain webhook URLs that can trigger automated deployments
The 'environment' field in the response contains the environment UID associated with the hook
Use cursor-based pagination for better performance with large datasets

get_latest_live_deployment.name: get_latest_live_deployment
get_latest_live_deployment.description: Retrieves the most recent live deployment for a specified environment or project. Returns comprehensive deployment details including build configuration, Git information, deployment status, and performance metrics.

mapper.query:
query LatestLiveDeployment($query: QueryDeploymentsInput!) {
  latestLiveDeployment(query: $query) {
    buildCommand
    commitHash
    commitMessage
    commitUrl
    createdAt
    deploymentNumber
    deploymentUrl
    durationInSeconds
    environment
    frameworkPreset
    gitBranch
    latest
    outputDirectory
    previewUrl
    project
    repositoryUrl
    serverCommand
    status
    uid
    updatedAt
  }
}

query.description: Query parameters to identify the deployment to retrieve. Specify criteria such as environment ID.

environment.description: Environment UID to get the latest live deployment for

create_deploy_hook.name: create_deploy_hook
create_deploy_hook.description: Creates a new deploy hook for an environment. Deploy hooks are automated triggers that initiate deployments when called via webhook URL, enabling integration with CI/CD pipelines and external automation systems.

deployHook.description: Deploy hook configuration object containing the environment and hook details

environmentUid.description: Environment UID where the deploy hook will be created. This determines which environment will be deployed when the hook is triggered.

name.description: Human-readable name for the deploy hook. Use descriptive names to identify the purpose or source of deployments

update_deploy_hook.name: update_deploy_hook
update_deploy_hook.description: Updates an existing deploy hook configuration. Allows modification of the deploy hook name and environment association while preserving the webhook URL and other metadata.

deployHook.description: Deploy hook update configuration containing the hook identifier and updated properties

deployHookUid.description: Unique identifier of the deploy hook to update

environmentUid.description: Environment UID of the deploy hook.

name.description: Updated name for the deploy hook

delete_deploy_hook.name: delete_deploy_hook
delete_deploy_hook.description: Deletes an existing deploy hook from an environment. This action permanently removes the deploy hook and disables its webhook URL, preventing future automated deployments through this hook.

deployHook.description: Deploy hook deletion configuration containing the hook identifier and environment context

deployHookUid.description: Unique identifier of the deploy hook to delete

environmentUid.description: Environment UID that owns the deploy hook (required for authorization and validation)

trigger_deploy_hook.name: trigger_deploy_hook
trigger_deploy_hook.description: Triggers an existing deploy hook for an environment. This allows for manual or automated re-deployments using the webhook URL associated with the hook.

deploy_hook_uid.description: Unique identifier for the deploy hook to be triggered

create_deployment.name: create_deployment
create_deployment.description: Creates a new deployment for the specified environment. Initiates the build and deployment process using the latest commit from the environment's configured Git branch.

mapper.query:
mutation Mutation($deployment: CreateDeploymentInput!) {
  createDeployment(deployment: $deployment) {
    buildCommand
    commitHash
    commitMessage
    commitUrl
    createdAt
    createdBy
    deploymentNumber
    deploymentUrl
    environment
    frameworkPreset
    gitBranch
    latest
    outputDirectory
    project
    repositoryUrl
    serverCommand
    status
    uid
    updatedAt
  }
}

deployment.description: Deployment configuration specifying the target environment and optional deployment parameters

environment.description: Environment UID where the deployment will be created

revalidate_cdn_cache.name: revalidate_cdn_cache
revalidate_cdn_cache.description: Revalidates the CDN cache for an environment when content or configuration is modified. Prompts the CDN to fetch the latest content from the origin server, ensuring visitors see the most up-to-date version across all domains in the environment.

revalidateCdnCache.description: CDN cache revalidation configuration. Always include environmentUid, then provide exactly one of cachePath, cacheTags, or hostnames to specify what to revalidate.

environmentUid.description: Environment UID where the CDN cache will be revalidated. This affects all domains associated with the environment.

cachePath.description: Revalidate by URL path. Use this OR cacheTags OR hostnames, not more than one.

path.description: URL path to revalidate (e.g., '/' for entire site, '/blog' for blog section, '/blog/my-post' for specific page). Path is applied across all domains in the environment.

isPrefix.description: Whether to revalidate nested paths under the specified path. Set to true to revalidate all URLs starting with the path (e.g., '/blog' revalidates '/blog/post1', '/blog/post2', etc.). Set to false to revalidate only the exact path.

cacheTags.description: Revalidate all routes tagged with these cache tags. Use this OR cachePath OR hostnames.

hostnames.description: Revalidate the cache for these specific hostnames (e.g., 'test.contentstackapps.com'). Use this OR cachePath OR cacheTags.

get_all_projects.name: get_all_projects
get_all_projects.description: Fetches the list of all projects in your organization with pagination support. Returns project details including repository information, organization UID, and metadata.

skip.description: Number of projects to skip in the output (e.g., skip: 2 to skip the first 2 projects)

create_a_project.name: create_a_project
create_a_project.description: Creates a project in Launch using either a Git Provider or File Upload. For Git Provider: connect your GitHub/Bitbucket account and provide repository details. For File Upload: first get a signed upload URL, then upload your ZIP file (valid for 10 minutes).

projectType.description: Type of project: GITPROVIDER for Git Provider (GitHub or Bitbucket) based projects or FILEUPLOAD for ZIP file uploads

environment.description: Initial environment configuration for the project. gitBranch is required for GITPROVIDER projects; FILEUPLOAD projects supply the build via fileUpload.uploadUid instead.

gitBranch.description: Git branch name (required for GITPROVIDER projects)

serverCommand.description: Server command for SSR frameworks (e.g., npm run start)

autoDeployOnPush.description: Enable automatic deployments on Git push

fileUpload.description: File upload information (required for FILEUPLOAD projects)

uploadUid.description: Upload UID obtained from the signed upload URL API

get_a_project.name: get_a_project
get_a_project.description: Fetches a specific project in Launch using the project UID. Returns comprehensive project details including repository configuration and metadata.

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the project to retrieve

update_a_project.name: update_a_project
update_a_project.description: Updates an existing project in your organization. Allows modification of project name and description.

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the project to update

project_data.description: The fields should be wrapped as an object {...data}

delete_a_project.name: delete_a_project
delete_a_project.description: Deletes an existing project in your organization. This action is permanent and will remove all associated environments and deployments.

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the project to delete

force.description: Force deletion even when the project still has dependent resources. Defaults to true.

get_all_environments.name: get_all_environments
get_all_environments.description: Fetches the list of all environments in a project with pagination support. Returns environment details including build settings, Git branch configuration, and domain information.

skip.description: Number of environments to skip in the output

create_an_environment.name: create_an_environment
create_an_environment.description: Creates a new environment in your Launch project. For Git Provider projects, specify the Git branch. For File Upload projects, first get a signed upload URL and upload your ZIP file (valid for 10 minutes).

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the project where the environment will be created

environment_data.description: Environment data. Provide gitBranch for GITPROVIDER projects or uploadUid for FILEUPLOAD projects (the two are mutually exclusive).

gitBranch.description: Git branch name (required for GITPROVIDER projects, must exist in repository)

uploadUid.description: Upload UID from signed upload URL (required for FILEUPLOAD projects)

serverCommand.description: Server command for SSR frameworks (e.g., npm run start)

autoDeployOnPush.description: Enable automatic deployments on Git push

get_an_environment.name: get_an_environment
get_an_environment.description: Fetches a specific environment from a project using the project UID and environment UID. Returns comprehensive environment details including build configuration, domains, and settings.

update_an_environment.name: update_an_environment
update_an_environment.description: Updates an existing environment in your project. Allows modification of build settings, Git branch, environment variables, password protection, and feature flags.

environment_uid.description: Unique identifier of the environment to update

environment_data.description: The fields should be wrapped as an object {...data}

delete_an_environment.name: delete_an_environment
delete_an_environment.description: Deletes an existing environment in your project. This action is permanent and will remove all associated deployments.

environment_uid.description: Unique identifier of the environment to delete

force.description: Force deletion even when the environment still has dependent resources. Defaults to true.

get_signed_upload_url_project.name: get_signed_upload_url_project
get_signed_upload_url_project.description: Fetches the signed URL where you must upload the ZIP file when creating a project via file upload. The signed URL is valid for 10 minutes. After getting this URL, upload your ZIP file, then use the uploadUid in the Create Project API.

get_signed_upload_url_environment.name: get_signed_upload_url_environment
get_signed_upload_url_environment.description: Fetches the signed URL where you must upload the ZIP file when creating an environment via file upload. The signed URL is valid for 10 minutes. Only available for FILEUPLOAD projects.

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the FILEUPLOAD project

get_signed_upload_url_deployment.name: get_signed_upload_url_deployment
get_signed_upload_url_deployment.description: Retrieves the signed URL where you must upload the ZIP file when creating or redeploying a deployment via file upload. The signed URL is valid for 10 minutes. Only available for FILEUPLOAD projects.

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the FILEUPLOAD project

environment_uid.description: Unique identifier of the environment where you want to create the deployment

get_signed_download_url_deployment.name: get_signed_download_url_deployment
get_signed_download_url_deployment.description: Returns the signed URL to download the uploaded file from the latest deployment. The signed URL is valid for 15 minutes (900 seconds).

project_uid.description: Unique identifier of the FILEUPLOAD project

deployment_uid.description: Unique identifier of the deployment (must be the latest deployment)

get_all_deployments.name: get_all_deployments
get_all_deployments.description: Fetches the list of all deployments within a specific environment with pagination support. Returns deployment details including build status, Git commit information, duration, and preview URLs.

skip.description: Number of deployments to skip in the output

get_deployment.name: get_deployment
get_deployment.description: Retrieves a specific deployment from an environment using the project UID, environment UID, and deployment UID. Returns comprehensive deployment details including status, build information, and performance metrics.

deployment_uid.description: Unique identifier of the deployment to retrieve

get_deployment_logs.name: get_deployment_logs
get_deployment_logs.description: Fetches the deployment logs of a specific deployment. These logs provide detailed build and deployment information, helping track the build process and identify issues. Supports optional timestamp parameter for pagination.

timestamp.description: UTC Zulu timestamp to fetch logs from (e.g., 2025-11-17T11:03:06.89Z). Used for pagination to get logs after this timestamp.

get_server_logs.name: get_server_logs
get_server_logs.description: Fetches the server logs of a specific deployment. These logs capture runtime information from deployed apps, helping monitor performance and debug runtime issues. Requires startTime and endTime parameters.

startTime.description: Starting time value in milliseconds since Unix epoch (e.g., 1763890624854)

endTime.description: Ending time value in milliseconds since Unix epoch (e.g., 1763977024960)
